title: movement_indicator dash assertion is vacuous after em-dash to hyphen swap
evidence:
Diff in movement_indicator_none_test:
-  html |> string.contains("—") |> should.be_true
+  html |> string.contains("-") |> should.be_true

Rendered markup always contains "-" via attributes, from movement_indicator.gleam:
    "none" ->
      html.span(
        [
          attribute("data-testid", "movement-none"),
          attribute("aria-label", "No change"),
          class("text-slate text-sm"),
        ],
        [html.text("-")],
      )
detail: Lustre serializes data-testid="movement-none" and class "text-slate text-sm" into the HTML, so a hyphen is always present regardless of the text node; the assertion can't detect the placeholder dash being dropped.
recommended_fix: Pin a fragment unique to the text node (e.g. the full span string or ">-<"), or assert on the element's text content, so removing the placeholder dash fails the test.
